gen-dafont-neon-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Neon glows with a vibrant, stamped-metal look, every stroke the same width and the letters spaced generously apart. Mochiy Pop One follows in a plain sans with a very large lowercase eye, so a bigger heading over smaller text feels right.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Glowing and loud, with tall stamped-metal lowercase. Mochiy Pop P One lets each letter breathe in wide gaps and a sizable lowercase, so the heading gets to be the show while the text hums along quietly.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-montserrat-underline: Uninterrupted strokes of identical width give Neon its glowing, stamped-metal character, with open gaps between every pair of letters. And Montserrat Underline brings a plain sans with round, breathing bowls and a lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-mozilla-headline: Bright, straight-edged and vibrant, Neon draws every stroke at a constant width. And Mozilla Headline, a sans-serif with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, keeps a long page approachable and contemporary underneath it.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text has tall lowercase that looks bold, with terminals flaring outward, while Neon above it holds a flat, unvarying line in every letter. And over a long stretch, the sans-serif text feels neutral and steady, a quiet floor beneath the glow.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans reads contemporary and clean, with a large central band and curved letters whose mouths stay wide open, like a technical pen at work. Neon looks best big.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-nobile: Nobile sits tight, with little gap between lowercase and caps. Make Neon small and its glowing, constant-width joints lose their punch, while Nobile's open plain sans mouths would feel oddly large if blown up.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-nokora: Vibrant, glowing and stamped-looking, Neon holds a technical-pen steadiness while Nokora lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line. Neon earns its keep big and short.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Glowing, first of all, with curves that never thin at the shoulders. Noto Kufi Arabic adds a modern, clean sans with open gaps in the c, and its capitals barely rise above the lowercase.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans: Neon glows in a vibrant, stamped-metal style, its joins as thick as its strokes and its lowercase standing tall. Noto Sans answers quietly, its wide-open c filling most of the letter height.
